Aspect fiend

Activate 1 command

Frequency once per day

Effect You bargain with the evil force empowering your relic for a boon, though you must trade something in return. Select one of the following benefits to gain.

  • Your relic attempts to counteract a harmful condition affecting you.
  • You regain @Damage[3d8+16[healing]] Hit Points.
  • You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls for 1 minute.

One of the following randomly determined effects occurs to you in payment, after applying the benefit.

  • You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.
  • You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.
  • You lose @Damage[1d8[untyped]] Hit Points.
  • You take a –1 penalty to damage rolls for 1 minute.
